objective: Choose a sensible scale for a bar graph.

stem.en: A class collected 10, 20 and 35 recycled cans on three days. Choose a scale for a bar graph and tell how many scale units each bar needs.
stem.es: Una clase recolectó 10, 20 y 35 latas recicladas en tres días. Elige una escala para una gráfica de barras y di cuántas unidades de escala necesita cada barra.

criteria.en: Chooses a scale that divides all three numbers, like 5
criteria.es: Elige una escala que divida los tres números, como 5

sample.en: With a scale of 5, 10 needs 2 units, 20 needs 4 units and 35 needs 7 units.
sample.es: Con una escala de 5, 10 necesita 2 unidades, 20 necesita 4 y 35 necesita 7.

hints.en: Pick a scale number that fits evenly into 10, 20 and 35.
Divide each amount by the scale.
Count by your scale to check.

steps: A scale of 5 divides all three amounts.

objective: Plot a value from a picture graph key.

stem.en: A picture graph key says each cup stands for 10 glasses of water. Class 1 drank 3 cups' worth. Plot how many glasses Class 1 drank (x is the class number).
stem.es: La clave de una gráfica de dibujos dice que cada taza vale 10 vasos de agua. La clase 1 bebió 3 tazas. Marca cuántos vasos bebió la clase 1 (x es el número de clase).

hints.en: Read the key before counting.
Each cup is worth 10.
Count by tens.

objective: Find the error when a graph scale is ignored.

stem.en: Each line on a bar graph's side stands for 5 votes. Nina reads the bar for pizza, which reaches the 6th line. Step 1: The bar reaches the 6th line. Step 2: She says each line is 1 vote. Step 3: She says pizza has 6 votes. Which step has the mistake?
stem.es: Cada línea en el lado de una gráfica de barras vale 5 votos. Nina lee la barra de pizza, que llega a la sexta línea. Paso 1: La barra llega a la sexta línea. Paso 2: Dice que cada línea vale 1 voto. Paso 3: Dice que la pizza tiene 6 votos. ¿Qué paso tiene el error?

steps: She says each line is 1 vote

hints.en: Look back at what each line is worth.
The scale tells you how much each line stands for.
Use the scale to multiply.

objective: Combine several bars of a graph.

stem.en: A bar graph shows apples = 35, pears = 20 and oranges = 45 pieces of fruit. How many pieces of fruit are shown in all?
stem.es: Una gráfica de barras muestra manzanas = 35, peras = 20 y naranjas = 45 piezas de fruta. ¿Cuántas piezas de fruta se muestran en total?

sample.en: 35 + 20 + 45 = 100 pieces of fruit.
sample.es: 35 + 20 + 45 = 100 piezas de fruta.

hints.en: All three bars are part of the total.
Add the three numbers.
Try adding 35 and 45 first.

objective: Match scaled bar descriptions to their values.

stem.en: Match each bar description to the number it stands for.
stem.es: Relaciona cada descripción de barra con el número que representa.

pairs.left: Reaches the 4th line, each line is 5
Reaches the 3rd line, each line is 10
Reaches the 6th line, each line is 2
Reaches the 7th line, each line is 3

hints.en: Multiply the number of lines by the worth of a line.
Read each scale carefully.
Skip count to check.

objective: Plot a value from a scaled picture graph.

stem.en: A picture graph key says each paw stands for 5 students. Dogs (category 3) have 4 paws. Plot how many students chose dogs.
stem.es: La clave de una gráfica de dibujos dice que cada huella vale 5 estudiantes. Los perros (categoría 3) tienen 4 huellas. Marca cuántos estudiantes eligieron perros.

hints.en: Read the key before counting.
Each paw is more than one student.
Skip count by the key amount.

objective: Read a scaled picture graph.

stem.en: In a picture graph, each star stands for 4 stickers. Ava's row has 6 stars. How many stickers does Ava have?
stem.es: En una gráfica de dibujos, cada estrella vale 4 calcomanías. La fila de Ava tiene 6 estrellas. ¿Cuántas calcomanías tiene Ava?

choices.why: That counts the stars as 1 each. Each star is worth 4.
That adds 6 + 4. Each star is 4, so multiply.
That writes the digits next to each other. Multiply 6 × 4.

hints.en: Check the key first.
Each star is worth the same amount.
6 groups of 4.

objective: Solve a two-step question from a picture graph.

stem.en: In a picture graph, each smiley stands for 3 students. Class C has 6 smileys and Class D has 3 smileys. How many more students are in Class C than Class D?
stem.es: En una gráfica de dibujos, cada carita vale 3 estudiantes. La clase C tiene 6 caritas y la clase D tiene 3 caritas. ¿Cuántos estudiantes más hay en la clase C que en la clase D?

choices.why: That is the difference in smileys. Each smiley is worth 3 students.
That adds the groups, 18 + 9, instead of finding the difference.
That is the number of smileys in Class C only.

hints.en: First find how many students each class has.
Use the key for each class.
Then subtract.

steps: Class C: 6 × 3 = 18 students; Class D: 3 × 3 = 9 students.

objective: Count data values on a line plot.

stem.en: A line plot of insect lengths has 3 dots at 2 1/2 inches, 2 dots at 3 inches and 4 dots at 3 1/2 inches. How many insects are longer than 3 inches?
stem.es: Un diagrama de puntos de longitudes de insectos tiene 3 puntos en 2 1/2 pulgadas, 2 puntos en 3 pulgadas y 4 puntos en 3 1/2 pulgadas. ¿Cuántos insectos miden más de 3 pulgadas?

choices.why: That counts only the insects exactly 3 inches long.
That counts insects that are 3 inches or more. Longer than 3 means only 3 1/2.
That counts every insect in the plot.

hints.en: Longer than 3 means greater than 3, not equal to 3.
Which dots are to the right of 3?
Count the dots above 3 1/2.

steps: Only the 3 1/2 inch insects are longer than 3 inches.
solution.es: Solo los de 3 1/2 pulgadas son más largos que 3: hay 4 puntos.

objective: Add data to a line plot.

stem.en: A line plot shows the lengths of 4 leaves in inches. Two more leaves are 5 inches long. Add two dots at 5 to show them.
stem.es: Un diagrama de puntos muestra las longitudes de 4 hojas en pulgadas. Otras dos hojas miden 5 pulgadas. Agrega dos puntos en 5 para mostrarlas.

hints.en: Each leaf gets one dot.
Both new leaves have the same length.
Add a dot above 5 two times.

steps: There were 4 dots. Add 2 more dots at 5.
solution.es: Se agregan 2 puntos en 5 y el diagrama tiene 6 puntos.

objective: Use a line plot of quarter-inch data to answer a question.

stem.en: A line plot shows plant growth in inches: 2 plants grew 1/4, 3 plants grew 1/2 and 1 plant grew 3/4. How many plants grew at least 1/2 inch?
stem.es: Un diagrama de puntos muestra el crecimiento de plantas en pulgadas: 2 plantas crecieron 1/4, 3 plantas crecieron 1/2 y 1 planta creció 3/4. ¿Cuántas plantas crecieron al menos 1/2 pulgada?

criteria.en: Includes the plants that grew 1/2 inch
criteria.es: Incluye las plantas que crecieron 1/2 pulgada

sample.en: At least 1/2 means 1/2 or more. 3 plants grew 1/2 and 1 plant grew 3/4, so 3 + 1 = 4 plants.
sample.es: Al menos 1/2 significa 1/2 o más. 3 plantas crecieron 1/2 y 1 planta creció 3/4, así que 3 + 1 = 4 plantas.

hints.en: At least means that amount or more.
Which dots are at 1/2 or to the right of it?
Do not count the 1/4 plants.

steps: Count the plants at 1/2 and at 3/4.

objective: Plot a measurement in halves on a line plot.

stem.en: A pencil measures 3 1/2 inches. On a line plot grid, plot the first dot for this length (x is inches, y is the dot count).
stem.es: Un lápiz mide 3 1/2 pulgadas. En una cuadrícula de diagrama de puntos, marca el primer punto para esta longitud (x son las pulgadas, y es el conteo de puntos).

hints.en: 3 1/2 means 3 and one half.
Halfway between 3 and 4 is the right spot.
Put a dot at the half mark after 3.

steps: Plot the point at 3.5 with a count of 1.
solution.es: 3 1/2 = 3,5: marca el punto en 3,5 con conteo 1.

objective: Plot a measurement in quarters on a line plot.

stem.en: A button is 2 1/4 inches wide. On a line plot grid, plot the first dot for this width (x is inches, y is the dot count).
stem.es: Un botón mide 2 1/4 pulgadas de ancho. En una cuadrícula de diagrama de puntos, marca el primer punto para este ancho (x son las pulgadas, y es el conteo de puntos).

hints.en: 2 1/4 is 2 and one quarter.
A quarter is the first mark after 2 on a ruler in fourths.
Put the dot just after 2.

steps: Plot the point at 2.25 with count 1.

objective: Find the difference between greatest and least values on a line plot.

stem.en: A line plot shows seed lengths. The longest seed is 4 inches and the shortest is 2 1/2 inches. How many inches longer is the longest seed? Write your answer as a fraction.
stem.es: Un diagrama de puntos muestra longitudes de semillas. La semilla más larga mide 4 pulgadas y la más corta mide 2 1/2 pulgadas. ¿Cuántas pulgadas más larga es la semilla más larga? Escribe tu respuesta como fracción.

hints.en: Write 2 1/2 as a fraction of halves.
Subtract the shortest from the longest.
Count halves from 2 1/2 up to 4.

objective: Mark a measurement in quarter inches on a ruler line.

stem.en: A ruler line from 2 to 3 inches is cut into quarters. A seed is 2 3/4 inches long. Mark the end of the seed.
stem.es: Una regla de 2 a 3 pulgadas está cortada en cuartos. Una semilla mide 2 3/4 pulgadas de largo. Marca el final de la semilla.

hints.en: The ruler is cut into 4 equal parts between 2 and 3.
2 3/4 is 2 plus three fourths.
Start at 2 and count 3 marks.

solution.es: Tres marcas de 1/4 después del 2 es 2 3/4.

objective: Plot repeated measurements on a line plot.

stem.en: Two pieces of yarn are each 1 3/4 inches long. On a line plot grid, plot the stack of dots for this length (x is inches, y is the dot count).
stem.es: Dos pedazos de lana miden cada uno 1 3/4 pulgadas. En una cuadrícula de diagrama de puntos, marca la pila de puntos para esta longitud (x son las pulgadas, y es el conteo de puntos).

hints.en: 1 3/4 is 1 and three quarters.
Two pieces mean the stack is 2 dots high.
Find the third quarter mark after 1.

steps: Plot the point at 1.75 with count 2.

objective: Choose the unit that measures area.

stem.en: Which of these is a unit for measuring the area of a classroom floor?
stem.es: ¿Cuál de estas es una unidad para medir el área del piso de un salón?

choices.why: Feet measure length, a distance along one line.
Pounds measure how heavy something is.
Liters measure liquid volume, not floor space.

hints.en: Area counts squares that cover a flat surface.
Look for a unit with the word square.
Length units measure along a line.

steps: Area is measured in square units.
solution.es: El área se mide en unidades cuadradas, como los pies cuadrados.

verify.note: Choosing a unit type is a concept check.

objective: Compare two areas given in unit squares.

stem.en: Shape A is covered exactly by 9 unit squares. Shape B is covered exactly by 12 unit squares. How many more square units does Shape B cover than Shape A?
stem.es: La figura A se cubre exactamente con 9 cuadrados unitarios. La figura B se cubre exactamente con 12 cuadrados unitarios. ¿Cuántas unidades cuadradas más cubre la figura B que la figura A?

hints.en: Area tells how many unit squares cover a shape.
To compare, find how many more.
Subtract the smaller area from the larger.

steps: 12 − 9 tells how many more squares B covers.

objective: Find the error when tiles leave gaps.

stem.en: Tom covers a rectangle with 6 unit squares, but there are gaps between the squares. Step 1: He places 6 unit squares. Step 2: He leaves gaps between them. Step 3: He says the area is 6 square units. Which step has the mistake?
stem.es: Tom cubre un rectángulo con 6 cuadrados unitarios, pero quedan espacios entre ellos. Paso 1: Coloca 6 cuadrados unitarios. Paso 2: Deja espacios entre ellos. Paso 3: Dice que el área es 6 unidades cuadradas. ¿Qué paso tiene el error?

steps: He says the area is 6 square units

hints.en: Area needs the squares to cover the shape completely.
Gaps mean part of the shape is not covered.
What should the squares do to each other?

steps: Unit squares must fit with no gaps or overlaps.
Leaving gaps is what causes the wrong count.
solution.es: Los cuadrados deben cubrir la figura sin dejar espacios.

verify.note: Whether tiles leave gaps is a conceptual requirement of area measurement.

objective: Build a rectangle with a given area from unit squares.

stem.en: A tray is 4 unit squares wide and 2 unit squares tall. Make it taller so that it is covered by 20 unit squares.
stem.es: Una bandeja mide 4 cuadrados unitarios de ancho y 2 de alto. Hazla más alta para que se cubra con 20 cuadrados unitarios.

hints.en: The width stays at 4.
20 squares in rows of 4 means how many rows?
Change only the height.

objective: Find all shapes with the same area.

stem.en: Select ALL the rectangles that are covered by exactly 12 unit squares.
stem.es: Selecciona TODOS los rectángulos que se cubren exactamente con 12 cuadrados unitarios.

choices.why: 5 × 3 is 15 squares, which is 3 too many.
2 × 5 is 10 squares, which is 2 too few.

hints.en: Count all the squares in each rectangle.
Rows times squares in a row gives the area.
Three rectangles have area 12.

solution.es: 3 × 4, 2 × 6 y 4 × 3 son 12; las otras dos no.

objective: Find area by counting unit squares that cover a shape.

stem.en: A rug is covered by 3 rows of unit squares with 4 squares in each row. There are no gaps or overlaps. What is the area of the rug in square units?
stem.es: Una alfombra está cubierta por 3 filas de cuadrados unitarios con 4 cuadrados en cada fila. No hay espacios ni se traslapan. ¿Cuál es el área de la alfombra en unidades cuadradas?

choices.why: That adds 3 + 4. Count all the squares: 3 rows of 4.
That counts only the rows, not every square.
That writes the digits next to each other. Multiply 3 × 4.

hints.en: Area counts the unit squares that cover the shape.
Each row has the same number of squares.
Count the squares in 3 rows of 4.

solution.es: 3 filas de 4 cuadrados son 12 cuadrados: área de 12 unidades cuadradas.

objective: Sort measurements by whether they describe area or length.

stem.en: Sort each measurement by whether it describes area (a flat surface covered) or length (a distance).
stem.es: Clasifica cada medida según si describe un área (una superficie plana cubierta) o una longitud (una distancia).

items.en: Paper needed to cover a box top
items.es: Papel para cubrir la tapa de una caja

hints.en: Area is about covering a surface.
Length is about how far along a line.
Ask: do squares cover it, or do you measure along it?

steps: Rugs, paper tops and grass cover surfaces.
Edges, heights and distances are lines.
solution.es: El área cubre una superficie; la longitud mide a lo largo de una línea.

verify.note: Classifying attributes (area vs length) is conceptual.

objective: Find the error when only border squares are counted.

stem.en: A rectangle is 5 squares wide and 4 squares tall. Lia counts only the squares along the edge. Step 1: She counts the squares on the edge only. Step 2: She counts 14 squares. Step 3: She says the area is 14 square units. Which step has the mistake?
stem.es: Un rectángulo mide 5 cuadrados de ancho y 4 de alto. Lia cuenta solo los cuadrados del borde. Paso 1: Cuenta solo los cuadrados del borde. Paso 2: Cuenta 14 cuadrados. Paso 3: Dice que el área es 14 unidades cuadradas. ¿Qué paso tiene el error?

steps: She counts the squares on the edge only
She says the area is 14 square units

hints.en: Area counts every square that covers the shape.
Lia skipped the squares inside.
Count all rows and columns.

steps: The edge has 14 squares, but the inside squares also cover the rectangle.
solution.es: El área cuenta todos los cuadrados: 5 × 4 = 20.

objective: Find the area of a plan drawn on a grid.

stem.en: A garden plan on a grid is 7 squares across and 5 squares down. Each square is 1 square meter. What is the area of the garden in square meters?
stem.es: El plano de un huerto en una cuadrícula mide 7 cuadrados de ancho y 5 cuadrados de alto. Cada cuadrado mide 1 metro cuadrado. ¿Cuál es el área del huerto en metros cuadrados?

sample.en: 7 × 5 = 35 square meters.
sample.es: 7 × 5 = 35 metros cuadrados.

hints.en: Each square is one square meter.
The grid has equal rows.
Multiply across by down.

objective: Match row descriptions to areas.

stem.en: Match each shape made of rows of unit squares to its area in square units.
stem.es: Relaciona cada figura hecha con filas de cuadrados unitarios con su área en unidades cuadradas.

hints.en: Multiply the number of rows by the squares in a row.
One row of 9 squares is the simplest.
Two shapes have areas between 15 and 16.

solution.es: Las áreas son 12, 15, 16 y 9 unidades cuadradas.

objective: Find the area of a grid shape with squares removed.

stem.en: A grid has 4 rows with 5 squares in each row. Two squares in one corner are not part of the shape. Each square is 1 square foot. What is the area of the shape?
stem.es: Una cuadrícula tiene 4 filas con 5 cuadrados en cada fila. Dos cuadrados en una esquina no son parte de la figura. Cada cuadrado mide 1 pie cuadrado. ¿Cuál es el área de la figura?

choices.why: That counts the whole 4 by 5 grid, including the two squares that are not part of the shape.
That adds the missing squares instead of removing them.
That adds 4 + 5. Multiply to count the squares in the grid first.

hints.en: First count all the squares in the full grid.
Then take away the squares that are not in the shape.
Rows times columns, then subtract.

objective: Count unit squares to find area.

stem.en: A rectangle is made of 5 rows with 4 unit squares in each row. What is its area in square units?
stem.es: Un rectángulo está hecho de 5 filas con 4 cuadrados unitarios en cada fila. ¿Cuál es su área en unidades cuadradas?

choices.why: That adds 5 + 4. Multiply rows by squares in each row.
That is the distance around, 5 + 4 + 5 + 4.
That writes the digits side by side.

hints.en: Each row has the same number of squares.
5 rows of 4 squares.
Think of 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 4.

objective: Find area by counting equal rows of squares.

stem.en: A mat is covered with 3 rows of 5 unit squares. How many unit squares cover the mat?
stem.es: Una colchoneta está cubierta con 3 filas de 5 cuadrados unitarios. ¿Cuántos cuadrados unitarios cubren la colchoneta?

hints.en: Each row has the same number of squares.
Count by 5s three times.
3 rows of 5.

objective: Find area from rows and columns of unit squares.

stem.en: A sticker sheet is made of unit squares in 3 rows and 6 columns. What is the area of the sticker sheet in square units?
stem.es: Una hoja de calcomanías está hecha de cuadrados unitarios en 3 filas y 6 columnas. ¿Cuál es el área de la hoja de calcomanías en unidades cuadradas?

hints.en: Rows and columns make equal groups of squares.
Each row has the same number of squares.
3 rows of 6 squares.

objective: Count unit squares in a shape made of rows.

stem.en: A shape on a grid has two rows of unit squares. The top row has 4 squares and the bottom row has 7 squares. How many square units cover the shape?
stem.es: Una figura en una cuadrícula tiene dos filas de cuadrados unitarios. La fila de arriba tiene 4 cuadrados y la de abajo tiene 7. ¿Cuántas unidades cuadradas cubren la figura?

hints.en: Count the squares in each row.
The shape's area is all of its squares together.
Add the two rows.

objective: Choose the expression for a rectangle split into two smaller rectangles.

stem.en: A rectangle is 6 units tall and 9 units wide. Mei splits the width into 5 + 4. Which expression gives the area of the whole rectangle?
stem.es: Un rectángulo mide 6 unidades de alto y 9 unidades de ancho. Mei divide el ancho en 5 + 4. ¿Qué expresión da el área de todo el rectángulo?

choices.why: The height 6 must go with both widths, not just the first.
That adds the sides. Area multiplies.
That multiplies all three numbers. The areas of the two parts should be added.

hints.en: The rectangle becomes two smaller rectangles.
Each has height 6.
Add the areas of the two parts.

objective: Find the error when sides are added to find area.

stem.en: Zeke finds the area of a rectangle that is 5 units by 6 units. Step 1: Area is the number of unit squares that cover it. Step 2: He adds 5 + 6. Step 3: He says the area is 11 square units. Which step has the mistake?
stem.es: Zeke halla el área de un rectángulo de 5 unidades por 6 unidades. Paso 1: El área es el número de cuadrados unitarios que lo cubren. Paso 2: Suma 5 + 6. Paso 3: Dice que el área es 11 unidades cuadradas. ¿Qué paso tiene el error?

steps: Area is the number of unit squares that cover it
He says the area is 11 square units

hints.en: 5 rows of 6 squares is equal groups.
Equal rows of squares call for multiplication.
Compare 11 with the number of squares in 5 rows of 6.

steps: 11 is only the sum of the sides.

objective: Explain why splitting a rectangle keeps the same area.

stem.en: A rectangle is 6 units by 4 units. Explain why cutting it into two 6 by 2 rectangles gives the same area as 6 × 4.
stem.es: Un rectángulo mide 6 unidades por 4 unidades. Explica por qué cortarlo en dos rectángulos de 6 por 2 da la misma área que 6 × 4.

criteria.en: Says cutting does not add or remove squares
criteria.es: Dice que cortar no agrega ni quita cuadrados

sample.en: Cutting does not change how many squares there are. Each part is 6 × 2 = 12, and 12 + 12 = 24, the same as 6 × 4.
sample.es: Cortar no cambia cuántos cuadrados hay. Cada parte es 6 × 2 = 12 y 12 + 12 = 24, igual que 6 × 4.

hints.en: Think about whether any square is lost when you cut.
Find the area of each part.
Add the parts and compare.

objective: Find the area of an L-shaped region by adding rectangles.

stem.en: An L-shaped playground is made of two rectangles. One rectangle is 8 meters by 3 meters. The other is 4 meters by 2 meters. What is the area of the whole playground in square meters?
stem.es: Un patio de juegos en forma de L está formado por dos rectángulos. Un rectángulo mide 8 metros por 3 metros. El otro mide 4 metros por 2 metros. ¿Cuál es el área de todo el patio en metros cuadrados?

sample.en: 24 + 8 = 32 square meters.
sample.es: 24 + 8 = 32 metros cuadrados.

hints.en: Find the area of each rectangle separately.
The L-shape is the two rectangles together.
Add the two areas.

objective: Split a rectangle into two parts to find its area.

stem.en: A rectangle is 7 units long and 8 units wide. Split the length at 5 so that you can find the area as two smaller rectangles.
stem.es: Un rectángulo mide 7 unidades de largo y 8 de ancho. Divide el largo en 5 para poder hallar el área como dos rectángulos más pequeños.

hints.en: The split shows the length as two parts.
One part is 5 long. How long is the other part?
Move the split to 5.

steps: Splitting 7 as 5 + 2 gives rectangles of 5 × 8 and 2 × 8.

objective: Find all rectangles with a given area.

stem.en: Which of these rectangles have an area of 24 square units? Choose every one.
stem.es: ¿Cuáles de estos rectángulos tienen un área de 24 unidades cuadradas? Elige todos.

choices.why: 5 × 5 = 25, one more than 24.
6 × 3 = 18, six less than 24.

hints.en: Multiply the two sides of each rectangle.
Look for a product of 24.
Three rectangles work.

solution.es: Tienen área 24: 3 por 8, 4 por 6 y 2 por 12.

objective: Use an equation to find the unknown side of a rectangle.

stem.en: A rectangular poster has an area of 48 square inches. It is 6 inches wide and L inches long, so 6 × L = 48. What is L?
stem.es: Un afiche rectangular tiene un área de 48 pulgadas cuadradas. Mide 6 pulgadas de ancho y L pulgadas de largo, así que 6 × L = 48. ¿Cuánto vale L?

hints.en: Length times width gives the area.
Which number times 6 makes 48?
Divide 48 by 6.

objective: Find an unknown side from an area.

stem.en: A rectangular rug has an area of 36 square meters. Its width is 4 meters. How many meters long is the rug?
stem.es: Una alfombra rectangular tiene un área de 36 metros cuadrados. Su ancho es 4 metros. ¿Cuántos metros de largo mide la alfombra?

hints.en: Area is length times width.
You know the product and one factor.
Divide the area by the width.

solution.es: 4 × largo = 36, así que el largo es 36 ÷ 4 = 9 metros.

objective: Find different rectangles with the same area.

stem.en: Give the side lengths of two different rectangles that each have an area of 16 square units. Show the multiplication for each one.
stem.es: Da las medidas de los lados de dos rectángulos diferentes que tengan cada uno un área de 16 unidades cuadradas. Muestra la multiplicación de cada uno.

criteria.en: First rectangle has area 16, like 2 by 8
criteria.es: El primer rectángulo tiene área 16, como 2 por 8

criteria.en: Second rectangle is different with area 16, like 4 by 4
criteria.es: El segundo rectángulo es diferente y tiene área 16, como 4 por 4

sample.en: 2 × 8 = 16 and 4 × 4 = 16, so a 2 by 8 rectangle and a 4 by 4 rectangle both have area 16.
sample.es: 2 × 8 = 16 y 4 × 4 = 16, así que un rectángulo de 2 por 8 y uno de 4 por 4 tienen área 16.

hints.en: Look for two numbers that multiply to 16.
Try the factor pairs of 16.
Check each by multiplying.

steps: Factor pairs of 16: 1 and 16, 2 and 8, 4 and 4.
solution.es: Los pares de factores de 16 son 1 y 16, 2 y 8, 4 y 4.

objective: Find the error when area is used for perimeter.

stem.en: Ada finds the perimeter of a rectangle that is 6 units by 4 units. Step 1: Perimeter is the distance around. Step 2: She multiplies 6 × 4 = 24. Step 3: She says the perimeter is 24 units. Which step has the mistake?
stem.es: Ada halla el perímetro de un rectángulo de 6 unidades por 4 unidades. Paso 1: El perímetro es la distancia alrededor. Paso 2: Multiplica 6 × 4 = 24. Paso 3: Dice que el perímetro es 24 unidades. ¿Qué paso tiene el error?

steps: She says the perimeter is 24 units

hints.en: Multiplying length by width finds a different measure.
Distance around means adding the sides.
Add all four sides: 6, 4, 6 and 4.
